status-effects-compendium.Name: Empty condition list
status-effects-compendium.Hint: Fills an empty Conditions compendium with the system conditions, restoring the token HUD conditions. Compendiums with content are never changed.

encumbered-status-sync.Name: Overloaded when adding or removing items
encumbered-status-sync.Hint: Updates Overloaded (Sobrecarregado) as soon as items are added to or removed from the sheet, without duplicating the condition.

armor-penalty-reduction.Name: Upgrades that reduce armor penalty
armor-penalty-reduction.Hint: Ajustada, Sob Medida and Mitral reduce the armor penalty (down to 0) instead of increasing it.

item-effects-on-actor-sheet.Name: Item effects on the actor sheet
item-effects-on-actor-sheet.Hint: Lists effects coming from items on the actor sheet, where they can be toggled, edited, deleted and dragged.

usage-effect-toggle.Name: Usage effects "Always Apply" toggle
usage-effect-toggle.Hint: The usage effect toggle switches "Always Apply" on and off, and the icon shows its state.

suppressed-usage-effects.Name: Usage effects of unequipped items
suppressed-usage-effects.Hint: Usage effects of unequipped weapons and equipment are no longer offered or applied on rolls.

temporary-usage-effect-expiry.Name: Temporary usage effects expiry
temporary-usage-effect-expiry.Hint: Temporary usage effects expire at scene end, by rounds or by time advancement, like other effects.

ability-dialog-cost.Name: Total cost in the usage dialog
ability-dialog-cost.Hint: "Total Mana Cost" adds the base cost and the checked enhancements, without double counting. Display only.

ItemEffects.DeleteContent: Delete the effect {effect} from the item {item}? This changes the item.

Notifications.error: Tormenta20 Community Patches: failed to apply the patch "{name}" ({reason}). Check the console (F12).
Notifications.fixed: Tormenta20 Community Patches: {reason} already fixes "{name}", so the patch was switched off.
Notifications.unverified: Tormenta20 Community Patches: the patch "{name}" was not applied: the bug could not be confirmed on {reason}, an unverified version.
Notifications.applied-unverified: Tormenta20 Community Patches: the patch "{name}" is still applied on {reason}, an unverified version, because the bug was detected.
Notifications.incompatible: Tormenta20 Community Patches: the patch "{name}" does not apply to {reason}.

Manager.Name: Patches
Manager.Label: Manage patches
Manager.Hint: Turns each patch on or off and shows its state on this Tormenta20 version.
Manager.Title: Tormenta20 Community Patches
Manager.Intro: Each patch is only applied while the bug exists. When Tormenta20 fixes the bug, the patch is switched off automatically. Changes require reloading the world.
Manager.PendingReload: Some saved changes only take effect after reloading the world (F5).

applied.Label: Applied
applied.Hint: The bug exists on this version; the patch is active.

applied-unverified.Label: Applied (unverified version)
applied-unverified.Hint: Version {reason} is unverified, but the bug was detected; the patch is active.

disabled.Label: Off
disabled.Hint: Patch turned off in this window.

fixed.Label: Fixed in the system
fixed.Hint: {reason} already fixes the bug; the patch is not applied.

unverified.Label: Unverified version
unverified.Hint: The bug could not be confirmed on {reason}; the patch is not applied.

error.Label: Error
error.Hint: Failed to apply: {reason}. Check the console (F12).
